body.name: m1
body.def: Under the full-support design and overlap, \(m_1\) denotes the unique continuous representative, whenever one exists, of the conditional-mean equivalence class \(x\mapsto\mathbb E_P[Y\mid A=1,X=x]\); the law of \(X\mid A=1\) is equivalent to \(\lambda\), so every continuous, and hence every Hölder-continuous, version is unique. Every pointwise derived-CATE or box condition on \(m_1\) refers to this representative.
